spec.mathematics: Drawing scaffold for the terminal ray at 300 degrees.

answer.worked:
Draw the terminal ray in quadrant IV, $60^{\circ}$ below the positive horizontal axis. Cosine is positive.
$$\begin{align*}A&=360^{\circ}-300^{\circ}\\A&=60^{\circ}\\\cos300^{\circ}&=\cos60^{\circ}\\\cos300^{\circ}&=\frac12\end{align*}$$

spec.mathematics: Drawing scaffold for the terminal ray at 150 degrees.

answer.worked:
Draw the terminal ray in quadrant II, $30^{\circ}$ above the negative horizontal axis. Cosine is negative.
$$\begin{align*}A&=180^{\circ}-150^{\circ}\\A&=30^{\circ}\\\cos150^{\circ}&=-\cos30^{\circ}\\\cos150^{\circ}&=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\end{align*}$$

answer.worked:
